title: pretty SIMONE|Plus Size Sparkly Midi Cocktail Dress
descriptionHtml:
Radiate elegance with our Plus Size Sparkly A-Line Midi Tulle Formal Wedding Guest Dress with Leaf Sequin. This stunning dress features intricate leaf sequin detailing that adds a touch of glamour to the A-line silhouette. The sparkly tulle fabric and midi length ensure a graceful and comfortable fit, designed to flatter plus-size figures, this dress ensures you look and feel beautiful on any special occasion.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi Length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
